q.line: Where the grapevines climb a convenient barn
stanza: Today I pulled three green frogs out of leaf and bark
Where the grapevines climb a convenient barn
I told them, "You will grow to be something tenacious and exalted;
You are mighty, you are gracious, you are lauded"
Then I let them go
Oh...

partner.line: Today I pulled three green frogs out of leaf and bark

q.line: The wall is high, the black barn
stanza: The wall is high, the black barn
The babe in my arms in her swaddling clothes
And I know soon that the sky will split
And the planets will shift
Balls of jade will drop
And existence will stop

q.line: I murdered her all in the barn
stanza: With her heart so light, she thought no harm
To meet me she did go
I murdered her all in the barn
And laid her body low

partner.line: With her heart so light, she thought no harm

q.line: She sent the father to the Barn
stanza: She sent the father to the Barn
Where he the ground did thrust
And there he found his daughter
Lay mingling with the dust

partner.line: And there he found his daughter
